answer: Agents bidding on cedar shipments, summit transport, or jade deliveries must each lock a $100 bond for 30 days before receiving one vote in marketplace governance. Splitting into fake identities creates no free voting power: controlling 1,000 votes requires locking $100,000 under the same rules. The bond makes influence costly through tied-up capital and forgone returns, though a wealthy attacker can still buy enough identities.
